The Lab Book organizes work around a lifecycle:

`plan -> acquire -> organize -> analyze -> validate -> collaborate -> communicate -> preserve`

Stages overlap and may repeat. A revised project plan can trigger new acquisition work; an intake discrepancy can require a scope decision. Each page distinguishes the **Draft minimum**, **Conditionally required**, **Recommended**, **Stronger practice**, **Example**, and **Stop and resolve** levels.

**Plan**, **Acquire**, **Organize**, **Analyze**, **Validate**, **Collaborate**, **Communicate**, and **Preserve** now have implemented draft guidance. Completing the lifecycle guidance does not mean that the Lab Book is institutionally approved policy.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  plan[Plan] --> acquire[Acquire]
  acquire --> organize[Organize]
  organize --> analyze[Analyze]
  analyze --> validate[Validate]
  validate --> collaborate[Collaborate]
  collaborate --> communicate[Communicate]
  communicate --> preserve[Preserve]
  acquire -. revise .-> plan
  validate -. revise .-> plan
```

## Choose a starting point

- [Starting a new project](../start/new-project.qmd) for a short gateway and initiation checklist.
- [Plan a project](plan/index.qmd) when purpose, scope, roles, outputs, or completion criteria are unsettled.
- [Plan data management](plan/data-management-planning.qmd) when access, storage, restrictions, identifiers, time, space, or computing need decisions.
- [Receive a one-time dataset](acquire/data-intake.qmd) when a file, archive, extract, sequence batch, raster, or field export arrives.
- [Design recurring or programmatic acquisition](acquire/recurring-programmatic-data.qmd) for APIs, databases, feeds, portals, and scheduled extracts.
- [Assess intake acceptance](acquire/data-intake.qmd#intake-completion-gate) when deciding whether incoming data can enter the Organize stage.
- [Organize accepted data](organize/index.qmd) when a snapshot has passed intake and needs controlled structure, provenance, schema, identifier, spatial, temporal, and readiness checks.
- [Review analysis readiness](organize/index.qmd#analysis-readiness-gate) before allowing a structurally documented dataset to enter Analyze.
- [Design an analysis](analyze/analysis-design.qmd) when the question, target, data version, method, and intended outputs need to be made explicit.
- [Distinguish exploratory and planned work](analyze/exploratory-and-planned-analysis.qmd) when decisions may have changed after seeing results.
- [Record an analysis execution](analyze/computational-execution.qmd) for local, notebook, scheduled, or HPC work.
- [Trace a result](analyze/results-and-traceability.qmd) when an estimate, figure, map, forecast, table, or simulation summary matters beyond a temporary exploration.
- [Plan validation](validate/validation-plan.qmd) when a candidate result needs a defined intended use, evidence, and reviewer.
- [Check assumptions and diagnostics](validate/assumptions-diagnostics-and-fit.qmd) when assessing how a method behaves for its stated use.
- [Validate a forecast](validate/prediction-and-forecast-validation.qmd) when predictions, risk maps, or forecasts are part of the claim.
- [Assess sensitivity and uncertainty](validate/sensitivity-robustness-and-uncertainty.qmd) when reasonable choices or uncertainty could change interpretation or action.
- [Record a validation conclusion](validate/validation-decisions-and-records.qmd) when evidence must be synthesized into a scoped decision.
- [Clarify roles and decisions](collaborate/roles-responsibilities-and-decisions.qmd) when shared work needs clear responsibility and decision authority.
- [Establish a working agreement](collaborate/working-agreements-and-shared-records.qmd) when contributors need shared locations, review, change, and access expectations.
- [Review shared work](collaborate/review-feedback-and-disagreement.qmd) when feedback, responses, or disagreement could affect the project.
- [Record contributions and credit](collaborate/contributions-credit-and-authorship.qmd) when contributors or expected outputs are changing.
- [Coordinate external partners](collaborate/external-partners-access-and-sharing.qmd) when access, sharing, or partner review conditions apply.
- [Onboard or hand off responsibility](collaborate/continuity-onboarding-and-handoff.qmd) when people, roles, or ownership change.
- [Choose a communication audience and product](communicate/audience-purpose-and-products.qmd) before drafting a consequential product.
- [Write claims linked to evidence](communicate/claims-evidence-uncertainty-and-limitations.qmd) when results need a defensible audience-facing interpretation.
- [Prepare figures, maps, and accessible alternatives](communicate/figures-tables-maps-and-accessibility.qmd) for visual or public products.
- [Select reporting guidance](communicate/manuscripts-reports-and-reporting-guidelines.qmd) for a manuscript, report, or model publication.
- [Prepare availability statements](communicate/data-code-software-and-availability.qmd) for data, code, software, or restricted inputs.
- [Review a release](communicate/review-approval-release-and-corrections.qmd) when an exact product version needs a release decision.
- [Record a correction or supersession](communicate/review-approval-release-and-corrections.qmd#corrections-withdrawals-and-supersession) when a released product changes.
- [Decide what to preserve](preserve/selection-retention-and-disposition.qmd) when a project closes, pauses, or has a retention trigger.
- [Assemble a preservation package](preserve/preservation-packages-manifests-and-metadata.qmd) when records or artifacts need a durable, identifiable scope.
- [Select a repository](preserve/repositories-identifiers-and-deposit.qmd) before transferring a package.
- [Verify integrity and recovery](preserve/fixity-storage-recovery-and-monitoring.qmd) after deposit and proportionately over time.
- [Preserve software and environments](preserve/formats-software-environments-and-reuse.qmd) when future execution or interpretation matters.
- [Review access restrictions](preserve/access-governance-maintenance-and-deaccession.qmd) when governance, maintenance, migration, or deaccession changes.

The Lab Book separates draft policy, task guidance, templates, and examples. The [Minimum GeoEpi Project Standard](../start/minimum-standard.qmd) supplies the governing draft framework; these pages explain how to satisfy relevant information requirements without prescribing one folder tree, storage platform, workflow engine, or environment.
